# One probe per line: VBA statements, then ``;;``, then the expression
# whose answer is recorded.  Each probe gets a document cleared of
# everything the probe before it left.
#
# Measured in live Word by ``python scripts/measure_vba_semantics.py
# word`` and replayed against the in-memory model by
# tests/test_word_model.py.

# --- the application and what it holds ---
;; TypeName(Application)
;; Application.Name
;; TypeName(ActiveDocument)
;; TypeName(ActiveDocument.Shapes)
;; TypeName(ActiveDocument.InlineShapes)
;; ActiveDocument.Shapes.Count
;; ActiveDocument.InlineShapes.Count
;; TypeName(ActiveDocument.Content)
;; ActiveDocument.Saved

# --- text ---
ActiveDocument.Content.Text = "Hello" ;; ActiveDocument.Content.Text
ActiveDocument.Content.Text = "Hello" ;; Len(ActiveDocument.Content.Text)
ActiveDocument.Content.Text = "One" & vbCr & "Two" ;; ActiveDocument.Paragraphs.Count
ActiveDocument.Content.Text = "One" & vbCr & "Two" ;; ActiveDocument.Paragraphs(1).Range.Text
ActiveDocument.Content.Text = "Hello" ;; ActiveDocument.Range(0, 2).Text
ActiveDocument.Content.Text = "Hello" ;; ActiveDocument.Content.Start
ActiveDocument.Content.Text = "Hello" ;; ActiveDocument.Content.End

# --- shapes ---
# Word reports Left and Top against the column and the paragraph, and
# AddShape places from the page, so the numbers here come back shifted
# by the margins.
#
# A shape's name is its kind and a number, and the number comes from a
# counter Word keeps per document that does not go back down when a
# shape is deleted.  These probes ask for the part of the name that
# does not depend on what ran before: the kind, and the step between
# two names made one after the other.
;; Left(ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name, 9)
;; Left(ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name, 26)
;; Left(ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape(9, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name, 4)
;; Left(ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name, 8)
;; Left(ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddLine(10, 20, 100, 50).Name, 19)
Dim n1 As String, n2 As String: n1 = ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape(1, 0, 0, 10, 10).Name: n2 = ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape(1, 0, 0, 10, 10).Name ;; CLng(Mid(n2, 11)) - CLng(Mid(n1, 11))
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes.Count
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; TypeName(ActiveDocument.Shapes(1))
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).Type
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddTextbox 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).Type
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddLine 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).Type
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).Left
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).Top
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).Width
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).Height
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).ZOrderPosition
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).AutoShapeType
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).RelativeHorizontalPosition
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).RelativeVerticalPosition
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name = "Box" ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes("Box").Left
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).TextFrame.TextRange.Text = "Hi" ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).TextFrame.TextRange.Text
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Left = 40 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).Left
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50: ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).Delete ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes.Count
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes("NoSuchShape").Name
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(2).Name
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; TypeName(ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).TextFrame)
ActiveDocument.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveDocument.Shapes(1).WrapFormat.Type
